title: Duty of department.
bodyText: The department of agriculture and biosecurity shall administer and enforce this chapter.
bodyHtml: §145-8  Duty of department.  The department of agriculture and biosecurity shall administer and enforce this chapter. [L 1951, c 74, pt of §1; RL 1955, §23-8; am L Sp 1959 2d, c 1, §22; am L 1961, c 132, §2; HRS §145-8; am L 2025, c 236, §17]
